summary: Completed live API and browser regression testing for the Srikanteshwara School website. Homepage, routed navigation, academics, admissions persistence, chatbot graceful failure, mobile menu, and responsive overflow checks passed.

minor.issue: Configured Gemini request currently returns an upstream 502/Cloudflare bad gateway response because the supplied Gemini integration is rejected or unavailable; frontend safely falls back to an unavailable message.

action_items: Validate or replace the supplied Gemini credential/model configuration when official chatbot responses are required.
critical_code_review_comments: Admissions submit handler marks every HTTP response as success without checking response.ok; non-2xx API responses should show an error state instead of success.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_ admissions enquiries via live regression checks; IDs were returned successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live checks covered health, enquiry POST, chat failure handling, all primary desktop nav routes, academics grade bands, admissions form success, mobile navigation, and mobile horizontal overflow. Resources/download clicks and every secondary route were not deeply exercised.
rca of the issue: POST /api/chat reaches the server-side Gemini call, which fails upstream and is surfaced as a 502. The browser catches the non-JSON/proxy failure and displays its fallback assistant message, so the user flow remains usable but live answers are unavailable.
